recentItems.description:

Marcos Moneta won Youth Olympic Gold in front of his home fans at Buenos Aires 2018. The Argentine would later backstop the sqaud to a bronze medal finish at Tokyo 2020 and was named the World Rugby Sevens Player of the Year in 2021

recentItems.title: 🔴 𝙇𝙄𝙑𝙀 Summer Youth Olympics! Opening Ceremony | #Dakar2026
recentItems.description:
📺 Upcoming live streams from #Dakar2026 ➡️: https://oly.ch/3WlhhcN

Dakar 2026 is officially making history as the first Olympic event ever hosted in Africa!  From October 31st – November 13th, 2026, Senegal will host 2,700 athletes and 207 delegations across 25 competitive sports and 10 engagement sports.

“Africa welcomes, Dakar celebrates” — get ready for an unforgettable Youth Olympic Games!
